t: This 4lite downlight bezel is a high-quality accessory designed for recessed lighting installations. Constructed from durable aluminium, it provides a sleek chrome finish, enhancing the aesthetic of any room. It is compatible with 4lite fire rated downlights, ensuring a secure fit for various projects. Ideal for electricians and fitters working on residential properties, this bezel offers a professional and polished look for ceiling lighting. The robust construction ensures longevity and a reliable performance in demanding environments.
